verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, such as bulk export of findings, review history, rules or governance data in open formats, and no documented offboarding path. Nearby items earn no credit. Config-as-code via .pr_agent.toml is an adjacent configuration feature. MCP and CLI retrieval of findings are developer building blocks. Self-hosted deployment and PR labels stored in the Git provider are adjacent or host-platform capabilities, not a product export capability.
